title: Shopping with Mum
instructions: Lea annesiyle alışverişe gidiyor. Ne aldıklarına ve ne almadıklarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: lea
script.text: Today I am at the supermarket with my mum.

script.speaker: lea
script.text: We need milk, bread, eggs and some fruit.

script.speaker: lea
script.text: I want some chocolate, but Mum says no.

script.speaker: lea
script.text: Then we go to the clothes shop. Mum buys me new shoes for school.

questions.prompt: Where are Lea and her mum first?
questions.evidence: Today I am at the supermarket with my mum.

questions.prompt: What does Lea get at the clothes shop?
questions.feedback: Annesi okul için yeni ayakkabı alıyor. Çikolata isteği reddedildi.
questions.evidence: Mum buys me new shoes for school.
